slots.notes: Fullscreen object-cover background video behind all hero content; JS-controlled fade loop (0.5s fade-in, 0.5s fade-out, resets to opacity 0 and replays on ended). No gradient overlays.
Navbar brand logo (src/assets/logo.png), rendered at 32px height on the dark hero background; transparency expected.

mechanic: Full-height flex column hero (navbar / flex-1 centered headline+subtitle+CTA / bottom logo marquee) over a JS-faded looping object-cover background video, with a blurred bg-gray-950 shape behind the centered gradient-clipped headline and a 20s translateX(0→-50%) infinite logo marquee.
techDelivery: React + Tailwind component spec (index.css CSS variables + custom liquid-glass utility, @fontsource/geist-sans, Fontshare General Sans, heroSecondary button variant); video fade loop driven by requestAnimationFrame.
reskinNotes: Headline 'AI' accent is a hardcoded inline linear-gradient(to left, #6366f1, #a855f7, #fcd34d) via bg-clip-text — not driven by a CSS variable, so a third gradient stop (#fcd34d amber) and the gradient direction live in markup. Layout is tuned to extreme fixed metrics (220px headline, leading-[1.02], tracking-[-0.024em]) and assumes the General Sans face; swapping fonts will shift the hero composition. Marquee brand icons are CSS liquid-glass tiles showing the first letter of each name (text + backdrop-filter, no image assets), so rebranding the logo row is a copy edit, and the 984x527 blur shape is a fixed-pixel decorative element.
